title: Gaudí Fold Field
description: The full-screen sibling of the Gaudí Column shader: the same procedural organic fold pattern from the column, rendered edge to edge across the whole plane in stone tones. Two extra misgeneration modes push it further — Moiré interference beats a high-frequency grid against itself into shimmering pink fringes, and Edge warping pinches and tears the field near its borders with hard high-contrast overfitted rings, like a neural net hallucinating detail. Mode, speed and fold scale are live; the beat nudges the speed.
